title: Open extension scalar/site square on flat models
statement:
Let $j:U\hookrightarrow X$ be an open immersion of schemes and let $A\to B$ be a unital map of finite commutative rings. Work in ordinary constant-ring module derived categories on the small etale and pro-etale sites [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories] [def-weil-pbc-proetale-modules]. Write $T=-\otimes_A^L B$, $N=\nu^*$ [def-weil-pbc-site-comparison-morphism], and $\delta:T N\cong N T$ for the canonical tensor comparison [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-tensor-pullback]. Let $t_j:Tj_{!,A}\cong j_{!,B}T$ be the sheaf tensor comparison, derived on K-flat models, induced by retaining each extension summand and tensoring its section with $b\in B$ [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-slice-extension-tensor]. Let $e_{j,R}:N_Xj_{!,R}^{\rm et}\cong j_{!,R}^{\rm pro}N_U$ be the canonical site comparison for $R=A,B$ [lem-cbc-proetale-extension-zero-comparison].
If $P$ is a bounded flat complex representing an etale object $L$, then $j_!P$ is flat termwise and K-flat on either site (on the pro-etale site use $N_UP$), and
$$j_{!,B}^{\rm pro}(\delta_{U,L})\circ t_j(N_UL)\circ T_X(e_{j,A}(L))=e_{j,B}(L_B)\circ N_X(t_j(L))\circ\delta_{X,j_{!,A}^{\rm et}L}.$$
These comparisons are natural in $L$. For composable open immersions $j_1,j_2$, their scalar comparisons satisfy $t_{j_2j_1}=j_{2!,B}(t_{j_1})\circ t_{j_2}(j_{1!,A}(-))$ after the canonical open compositors [lem-cbc-extension-zero-composition]; the site comparisons obey the corresponding composition identity. Identity opens give identity comparisons. Flatness and K-flatness use [def-pc-flat-sheaf-modules] [def-pc-kflat-complex].
